long_biography.plain_text:
Adalı's business career grew from a construction company founded by his father, Hasan Adalı, in 1962. The group's early road and military-facility contracts expanded into quarries, ready-mixed concrete, motorway works and large international projects. Şevki Adalı established its international and United States arm, directing construction, logistics and renewable-energy programmes while working with the executive team on projects across several countries.

The family platform later broadened into hydropower, wind energy and hospitality, including the Sheraton Adana. Its infrastructure portfolio covers dams, water systems, transport works and complex public facilities. Outside the corporate group, Adalı served as president of Adanaspor, one of the city's professional football clubs.

uncertainties.detail: Türkiye Gazetesi directly names Şevki Adalı as ZanZiba's purchaser and owner at the 2015 launch, identifies the yacht as an Adalı Group asset and matches the authoritative 40-metre dimensions. The family-company and Adanaspor descriptions independently match the official and Sabah identity. This is direct owner evidence rather than a vessel-only inference.

The authoritative relationship begins in 2013, while the public report says construction began for a British buyer in 2007, stopped after that buyer's 2008 insolvency, and later resumed after Adalı purchased the unfinished vessel before its 2015 launch. The 2013 date fits the reported mid-build acquisition and requires no correction.

The authoritative record, official company page and Turkish reporting use Şevki Adalı. Searches also covered Sevki Adali and Shevki Adali transliterations. The original Turkish orthography is retained, and no name correction or alias proposal is needed.

Searches returned an Adalı Teknik Tarım owner, same-name social profiles and other Turkish professionals. None supplied the combined Adalı Holding, Hasan and Serdal family, Adanaspor, NGA Build and ZanZiba anchors, so no career facts or personal social links were transferred from them.

Sabah identifies Şevki as Adalı Holding chairman, while NGA Build's current leadership page lists Hünkar Adalı as chairman of that operating company and credits Şevki with establishing and directing its international and United States group. These are treated as distinct holding and operating-company roles; no ownership percentage or sole-control claim is made.

Hasan Adalı founded the business in 1962 and is independently identified as Şevki's father. The dossier classifies Inherited and expanded because Şevki entered that family platform and built its international and renewable-energy activities. It does not infer the legal mechanism, timing or amount of any share transfer or estate distribution.

Construction & Engineering is the strongest current primary sector rather than Diversified; the material energy portfolio is captured separately in biography and tags.
